title: Reliability Testing for Natural Language Processing Systems
benchmark_measurement: The paper proposes a framework (DOCTOR) for reliability testing. In its taxonomy of potential dimensions to test, it includes 'Religion' as a sensitive attribute, suggesting measurements could focus on biases related to religious names and the handling of reclaimed religious slurs. No actual measurement was performed.
findings: The paper does not present experimental findings on religion. It proposes that 'Religion' should be a dimension for reliability testing of NLP systems, specifically suggesting tests for fairness related to religious names and the use of reclaimed slurs to prevent discrimination.
